text: ピカチュウ　ほしいなー　ぼくの　ピッピと　こうかんして！

structure.jp: ピカチュウ　ほしいなー
ぼくの　ピッピと　こうかんして！

patterns.name: 〜て (request)
patterns.explanation: Ending a sentence on the て-form of a verb is a casual way to ask someone to do it. こうかんして = 'trade with me'.

patterns.name: 〜なあ
patterns.explanation: なー at the end shows the speaker is voicing a feeling, half to himself. ほしいなー = 'I really want one...'.
